body:
Part of #1509.

The maintainer (2026-11-13, on #1517): "Trochoidal should land on 2D and 3D Adaptives to start with tho (see issues)"; decision on #1509: "trochoidal lands as a Method of the 2D and 3D Adaptive operations".

#1509's PR lands the 2D half: `OpParams::Adaptive2D.method` (`AdaptiveMethod::Spiral | Trochoidal`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_method.rs`), with the trochoidal lane in `adaptive_troch.rs`. 3D Adaptive is not touched.

Wanted: 3D Adaptive gets the same Method choice (default Spiral, every existing 3D Adaptive byte-identical). Under Trochoidal each closed level area is cleared by the trochoidal planner instead of the HSM plan (`machining3d::hsm` is the per-level port of the 2D plan; the level areas come from the slicer, so they are rarely single channels).

Depends on the multi-lane trochoid for wide and branching regions (filed beside this one, also Part of #1509): a 3D level area is seldom one channel, so the single-lane method of the first slice would refuse most levels. Related: #6 (3D Adaptive's internal trochoidal fallback, blocked on #47), #1517 (3D Adaptive gets a Method choice).

Done means: 3D Adaptive has Method = Spiral | Trochoidal (page, project file with old files defaulting, undo, MCP parameter); under Trochoidal every level stays inside its level area and above the model (the gouge laws and the post's stock sim), a level the method cannot cut is refused or falls back by name; golden CL; structural UI test.
